verses.1: Mash’as Babylon, who saw Yeshua as the son of Amoz.
verses.2: On Mount Neishpeh Sheu-Nes, they were called upon. They raised their hands and came forth from the gates of generosity.
verses.3: I have commanded my priests to sanctify me. I also called upon my rulers to be kind and merciful to me.
verses.4: The cry of the mountains resembles the cries of many people. It’s like the cries of kings from various nations. Jehovah gathers his armies to lead them into battle.
verses.5: The LORD comes from a place far away from the edge of the sky. With all His wrath, He will destroy the entire earth.
verses.6: They feared that the day of Jehovah was approaching, when He would come from His temple.
verses.7: Therefore, all hands will be broken, and every human heart will be broken.
verses.8: And the soldiers and officers were terrified. They rushed forward like frightened people. One man rushed at his fellow soldier, and their faces turned red with fear.
verses.9: Now, the day of Jehovah has come. He will pass over this land and destroy its sins from it.
verses.10: For the stars in the sky and their companions do not shine with light. The darkness of the sun prevails when it sets, and the wind does not spread its light.
verses.11: And I have dealt harshly with Egypt, and with those who are evil. I have punished the wicked and arrogant ones.
verses.12: One is a human being from afar, and the other is a man from Kethem.
verses.13: Therefore, the heavens were filled with noise and turmoil on account of God’s army. And on the day of judgment, it will be destroyed.
verses.14: And they will be like sheep that have been scattered abroad, without anyone to take care of them. They will turn back to their own land, and no one will take them away from there.
verses.15: All that is found will be destroyed, and all that is lost will be gone forever.
verses.16: And their children will be destroyed before their eyes. Their daughters will be taken away as slaves.
verses.17: I am from a city where people do not value gold or silver at all. They do not desire those things at all.
verses.18: And the stubbornness of young men will be punished; their fruitless actions will not be forgiven. Their eyes will not be healed.
verses.19: And Babylon would become a glorious kingdom, like the stars in the sky. It would be a masterpiece of God’s creation, just as He created Sodom and Gomorrah.
verses.20: He shall not sit forever, nor lie down from generation to generation. There shall be no more evil spirits or monsters to torment him there.
verses.21: And there were many Greeks living there. Their homes were filled with brothers and sisters. And the daughters of Ya’na and Sheirim danced there.
verses.22: And they answered with sighs in their homes, and with cries in those rooms that were close to the entrance. Their days will not be long-lived.
